reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established electron–phonon coupling theory, though the complexity of multicomponent alloy systems introduces some uncertainty.
reasons.testability: Systematic addition of a sixth element and direct measurement of Tc, combined with structural and compositional verification, provides a clear and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a core mechanism behind superconductivity in high-entropy alloys and offers a concrete experimental roadmap for researchers.
